Name: Evelyn Carter

Work Experience:
- 2023--2024: Research Intern, Goldman Sachs Global Investment Research. Conducted quantitative analysis of financial markets using Python and R; implemented factor models to forecast equity returns; collaborated with senior analysts on macroeconomic research reports and contributed to client presentations summarizing financial trends.
- 2022--2023: Data Science Intern, J.P. Morgan Asset Management. Developed machine learning models to identify portfolio optimization opportunities; analyzed large-scale financial datasets to detect risk exposure patterns; visualized key performance indicators for portfolio managers using Tableau dashboards.

Education:
- 2020--Present: Ph.D. in Financial Engineering, Columbia University. Main courses: Stochastic Processes in Finance, Computational Asset Pricing, Machine Learning for Quantitative Trading, Advanced Econ
